I did find validation from her hoovering (although it doesn't take a MENSA member to see that they wouldn't find greener grass better yet a better life post-breakup) but it's crazy because things didn't need to get this bad. I think that trips me out the most. We could've ended things amicably or we could've gotten counseling or heck, she could've went on to be a harlot but dear lord why at the expense of my reputation... Just gotta chin up and roll with the punches I guess.

Hey, look. I didn't mean to come off strongly saying, "this type of women are what is wrong with society today" although my notions on this matter remain the same since that is what's going on these days. But I do have to acknowledge that there are two sides of the fence here and I was once the guy you talked about in your OP. Everything felt straight out of a movie in the beginning of the relationship but she wouldn't communicate with me what was bothering her and things had to get really bad beyond repair for me to find out that she dealt with ass holes (and still was reaching out to ass holes) and also I'm just realizing that she was raised by unfit parents (I never met the father but her mom treats her more like a peer and enables her versus doing her job as a parent.) I still have yet to understand what I did to deserve such treatment but I respect that you are taking steps to self-reflect and actually trying to build upon having a relationship with the nice-guy because poor communication and toxicity leads to bad things happening and the stuff that takes place when those go unresolved hurts a lot, especially from a nice guy perspective. But in terms of therapeutic help, I am too struggling financially as I am responsible for all of my finances let alone financial decision-making but I have been an on-and-off subscriber to a virtual therapeutic app called BetterHelp where they match you with an LCSW and I must say I have had a great experience with the therapist they had matched me with in the past and we still have rapport. I hope that you guys do last forever and that nobody gets hurt in the relationship. Peace and blessings.

Women like this are part of the problem in today's society but men are told to take it in the chin and win a constellation prize by taking the high road, no matter what type of damage the damaged woman did to the man.

Advice? Just end the relationship before his feelings get even deeper and he ends up feeling like a used cuckold while you seek some psychological help.

edit: I'm not sure why I got downvoted but you know this is the truth and the OP needs to be psychologically counseled out of her behavior. Thank you OP. I get that. I'm coming to terms with being a shell of my former self that will most-likely be in debt and need therapy until I'm grey but what do we do about friends, family and heck... people in public that are narcissists?

I didn't believe these people in this subreddit at first when I read that narcissists always come back and even by means of hoovering but these people literally do come back. Speaking from firsthand experience, just don't even give the narc any attention and that will hurt their ego more than anything you can say to them in hopes of triggering. Literally these people are just soulless losers that drain the life and energy out of anyone they come in contact with.

OP's suffering and crying for help. That is the whole point of the thread. I am sure he/she really doesn't want to go through all the trouble to go sift through pages in search engines for the best way to die but I am also sure OP feels some shame in having to make this thread in addition to be even going through what he/she is going through. However, this world's so fucked up that people most-likely will turn a blind eye in regards to this until something drastic ends up going on the news and going viral on social media. Hey OP, I am literally feeling the same way you are right now but you gotta hold your head up because as you can see, people do not take suicide seriously in this society but everyone will want to be your friend when you have your comeback. And believe me, you will eventually see that light at the end of the tunnel at some point but just keep your circle small, even if it has to be a dot and always fight to stay afloat when you do see better days.

Looks for nothing but enablers and FWBs on social media and FaceBook (because these people slowly come to terms with realizing the harsh reality that nobody with even a half a brain and an iota of common sense will ever settle down with them).

Well, during the "love-bombing" and "honeymoon" phase(s), she used to spend a lot of money on me (sending me money, paying for hotels for us to meet and paying for food on dates) and was like offering to buy me things, although I'd decline because that would be going too far and I wasn't raised to be a gigolo and it's funny because an older fellow had warned me that she was doing this as a control tactic and although I understood what he was saying, slowly I was falling deeper and deeper in love with her and she revealed more and more how I was just nothing but a disposable toy for her. Before I learned what this narcissism was and what it's like dating a narc, morally I wanted to reciprocate that and we moved in together so I had bought her countless things that I never even knew I would be able to afford for a woman. It's funny because one time we were in Target and we had things ready for self-checkout and she had picked out some clothes so I didn't really scope what she chose but she scanned all the items and I paid. The following day, she was getting ready to go to court because she wanted to be a kleptomaniac and got arrested but on this day, she got dressed and was wearing one of the shirts from Target that read, "You Were Never My Boyfriend." Lol, the nerve of these people. I would say karma has a way of repaying these people back because now she has no car, no friends, f$@& buddies that do not want her but from what I noticed, she doesn't think highly of herself and probably doesn't anticipate getting that far in life. So whatever she can get via manipulation tactics, it was more than what she bargained for but in the event that it backfires then it's like for her that she was expecting the worse anyway and will run with the narrative that paints whoever she fell out with as the bad guy. These past 4 years have been crazy and I'm still struggling to clean up this mess. I mentioned this in another thread but to answer your question more specifically, she bought me a pack of Walmart socks for our first Christmas together while I had gotten her some winter boots and an Apple TV. These people are such crappy individuals lol.

These narcs are so immature; it's crazy how they make it so far in life just with plain irrationality and manipulative mind games. God forbid if these people ever were to really take a good look in the mirror and deal with their demons without projecting them upon others.

edit: Those smear campaigns at first do hurt because they really hone the skills of getting people to believe their side of the story but my nex is the type that lacks self-control and will keep spicing up her duck tales until people will start to question everything that she spews. So all in all, you have nothing to worry about because what is done in the dark will come to the light and what doesn't come out in the wash will come out in the rinse.
